sources.entry: IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition - IntelliJ IDEA is an integrated development environment written in Java for developing computer software

summary.one_liner: The open-source part of the JetBrains IDE codebase, used to build and run IntelliJ IDEA Community and the IntelliJ Platform from source.
summary.what_it_does: The README covers cloning the repository (with a shallow-clone option), fetching the Android modules via getPlugins scripts, and opening the source in IntelliJ IDEA through a Bazel project file. It describes building the IDE with a bazel-build-all-community script and producing installers with installers.cmd, including a Dockerized build option. It also explains running the built IDE from the IDE or the command line via bazel.cmd, and running tests in CI with tests.cmd and optional test filters and debug flags. The README states that the project is being migrated to the Bazel build system.
use_cases: run IntelliJ IDEA tests in CI
how_to_run: git clone https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community (use --depth 1 for a shallow clone)
./getPlugins.sh (Unix) or getPlugins.bat (Windows) to fetch Android modules
notable: Official source for IntelliJ IDEA Community and the IntelliJ Platform
Bazel-based build with preconfigured run and test scripts
Dockerized build environment for producing installers
Test runs filterable by configuration or test pattern, with debug options
caveats: Building requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or newer plus the Bazel plugin; building with only built-in IDE capabilities is no longer supported
Build system migration to Bazel is in progress, with rough edges and some tests not yet runnable under Bazel
On Windows, git long-path and autocrlf settings are needed before cloning
